Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Quebec City hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 14 of the 18 Quebec City hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Hotels.com at 4, Super.com at 4, Agoda at 1, Bluepillow.in at 1, the hotel's own site at 1, Tripadvisor.com at 1, TUI.com at 1 and Vio.com at 1. Taxes and fees at Quebec City hotels

At the 10 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 19% ($21 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 19% at Auberge Saint-Pierre to 20% at Auberge Place d'Armes. At 8 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
